# Prospective paired research experiment (EXT-EVAL-v1)

Registered by owner-authorized correction CR-2026.11.11-R3 before any v24.15 scored card. Amends the unstarted EXT-H1/FREEZE-H1 draft designs; original text stays preserved in HYPOTHESIS_REGISTER. No retrospective baseline, source time, prediction or availability feature may be backfilled.

## Population and frozen comparisons

Retain every requested event, including refused, unavailable, qualitative and NO_FORECAST outcomes. The confirmatory population is the first 100 or more eligible paired settled events issued under the unchanged v24.15 method, collected across at least eight settled ISO weeks. The one decision is at the close of the first ISO week satisfying both floors; include all eligible events in that completed week. After that frozen cohort is written, do not expand it until significance appears. No favourable-seed selection or early success stop.

Freeze four separate model identities on identical supplied contract keys and one declared evidence horizon:

1. SINGLE_RESEARCH:v24.15: the repository writer's supported forecast before external research is exposed.
2. FIVE_LANES:v24.15: after the current accepted five-role evidence package, using the same reference and legal adjustment mechanism.
3. REFERENCE:v24.15: the frozen pre-research reference.
4. BASELINE:v24.15: the identical-contract league baseline.

Use the existing append-only hash-verified prospective ledger, with actual pre-start freeze and externally audited publication receipts. A local clock/hash alone is not publication proof. Inability to support one side of a pair remains an explicit exclusion, never a backfilled prediction. Same-row comparisons use compatible period, endpoint, action and settlement definition. Outcomes use one validated effective revision per key.

## Primary question, dependence and precision

The primary estimand is event-equal FIVE_LANES minus SINGLE_RESEARCH Brier score, averaged within event then within ISO week. The practical improvement is -0.01; the paired week interval must exclude zero, the mean must be at most -0.01, and existing calibration/log-loss guards must pass before an owner recommendation. Baseline and reference comparisons are secondary and reported regardless of result. One event with many contracts is one dependent event, never many independent games. One hundred events/eight weeks are floors, not guaranteed power or route calibration. Report the achieved precision and competition/contract strata; do not generalize an NBA result to another league.

```text
python -m ml external evaluate --forecasts VERIFIED_PROSPECTIVE_LEDGER.csv --outcomes EFFECTIVE_OUTCOMES.csv --out NEW_REPORT
```

The command uses the existing proper-score evaluator and exact 100-event/eight-week floor. It cannot certify publication, source truth, causal effects or new-sport calibration and never promotes a model. Those audits remain explicit owner review gates.

## Coverage and effort

For every event retain lane start/completion, writer-review minutes and owner-transfer minutes; report wall time separately from summed labour. Preserve request-to-card counts, every exclusion reason, delayed/late issues, missing-source rates, corrected factual errors, independence status and exact scope. Compare retained coverage and calibration alongside scoring so selective abstention cannot hide failures. Report disagreements as diagnostics; EXT-H1 does not itself establish the benefit of five chats.

## Availability learning

Existing historical player-availability count is zero. Collect both sides' source-bound pregame snapshots now; do not invent historic absences. Estimate an absence effect only after the predeclared 200-card sport-specific collection and independent held-out check. Dataset size and a passing schema do not prove predictive value. Learning readiness remains FEATURE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE until the actual required rows exist.


## v24.15 operational amendment

The owner authorizes this release before any v24.14 card was issued. Freeze SINGLE with research-ops freeze-single before any packet release or return exposure, then freeze-five after actual current FULL_FIVE admission. Weekly audited source snapshots retain v24.15 method identity. Reduced and six-role runs are separate diagnostic cohorts; changed evidenced horizons cannot form unchanged-horizon pairs. Partial numeric coverage uses identical complete contract keys, with all unpriced/excluded/requested denominators reported. Fact scorecards after 20-30 games are descriptive checks of evidence accuracy, never early stopping or promotion. TEAM-CENTRE-v1 remains outside this frozen primary comparison. The real five-chat pilot remains PENDING until actual inputs/returns and effort evidence exist.
